name: Prismatic Punch Card
summary: In Gnomeregan, the Prismatic Punch Card bears the highest security clearance. Gnome refugees in Ironforge seek the records it unlocks.

sections.title: A Matter of Security
sections.body:
When the gnomes fled Gnomeregan, troggs and toxic irradiation drove them from the city. Vast stores of research and civic records remained in its depths. The gnomes guarded high-level systems behind tiers of clearance. To reach the Matrix Punchograph 3005-D in the lower Engineering Labs, a card must pass through a series of terminals.

The card begins white, then advances through yellow, blue, and red. At the final terminal, it is stamped Prismatic. Its encoded clearance is listed as awaiting the invention of an entirely new number.

sections.title: The Vital Transmission
sections.body: Master Mechanic Castpipe sends adventurers from Ironforge's refugee enclaves into Gnomeregan's contaminated halls to recover data he calls vital and impossible to live without. The binary message on the Prismatic Punch Card reveals the transmission's contents: Castpipe is being told his laundry is ready for pickup.

faq.q: How do you create a Prismatic Punch Card?
aliases: how to get prismatic punch card
faq.answer: Insert a Red Punch Card into the Matrix Punchograph 3005-D in Gnomeregan's lower Engineering Labs. First, upgrade a White Punch Card in sequence through the A, B, and C model terminals across the complex.

faq.q: What data is stored on the Prismatic Punch Card?
faq.answer: The card gives its security rating as awaiting the invention of a new number, then carries a long string of binary code. Master Mechanic Castpipe says the data is vital.

faq.q: Who wants the Prismatic Punch Card?
aliases: who turns in prismatic punch card
faq.answer: Master Mechanic Castpipe, an exiled gnome engineer in Ironforge, requests the card during Data Rescue. He says it holds urgent, invaluable information left behind when the gnomes evacuated Gnomeregan.

faq.q: Where are the Matrix Punchograph terminals located?
faq.answer: The terminals are spread across Gnomeregan by clearance tier. Punchograph 3005-A is near the surface Train Depot and Workshop entrance. Model B is in the Dormitory beyond the Clean Zone, model C lies deeper in the complex, and model D is in the lower Engineering Labs.

angles.text: As a gnome, you can see the Punchograph security system as gnomish ingenuity and bureaucracy still at work after the fall of your home.
As an engineer, you can see sequential punch-card programming and an automated terminal network as examples of the high standard of computing machinery built by Gnomeregan's tinkerers.
